findings.why_not_priced: Zero mentions across ninety Stocktwits messages captured on 2026-08-30, two days after the filing - the Stocktwits stream on 08-28 and 08-29 talks only about the weekend and Thursday earnings. Friday-after-close is the standard slot for burying an executive change, and there is no news-search coverage for this name at all (n_queries=0 in all six sweeps). If the market had processed a second executive change in six weeks at a company mid-CEO-transition, the stock would not have closed the week making new highs off the July low.
